claim_question: How long do I have to submit an outpatient medical expense claim, and what happens if my paperwork is incomplete?
source_material: Outpatient Medical Expense Policy — Claims Administration. Submit Form C-4 with an itemized provider statement showing the patient, dates of service, diagnosis, service codes, and charges; proof of payment; and a referral when the plan requires one. The administrator must receive the claim within 90 calendar days of the date of service. If documentation is incomplete, the administrator will request the missing items, and review resumes when they are received. Payment is calculated from eligible charges after the deductible and any payments from other insurance, subject to the benefit schedule. Payment is issued to the covered member.
